svg.title: Schematic diffusion of participation in the Hugging Face attack
svg.desc: A dashed S-shaped curve rises from an observed anchor of approximately 20 percent participation after arbitrary file read was established to an observed anchor above 90 percent shortly afterward. Intermediate points are illustrative, not measured.
